title: AdaMamba: Adaptive Frequency-Gated Mamba for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2604.23239v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time-series forecasting is foundational to a wide spectrum of web-scale services, spanning personalized recommendations, energy scheduling, and infrastructure capacity planning. Accurate long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) requires models to capture long-range temporal dependencies while adapting to periodic patterns that vary across variables. Although frequency-aware methods offer a global view of temporal dynamics, they typically rely on inflexible heuristic designs, such as predefined period lengths, manually selected or randomly sampled top-k frequency components, and separate spectral transformations. Consequently, they fail to account for time-frequency heterogeneity, where variables that appear synchronized in the time domain can differ substantially in the frequency domain. translated_title: AdaMamba：用于长期时间序列预测的自适应频率门控Mamba模型
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测是广泛的网络级服务的基础，涵盖个性化推荐、能源调度和基础设施容量规划。准确的长期时间序列预测（LTSF）要求模型能够捕捉长程时间依赖性，同时适应跨变量变化的周期性模式。尽管频率感知方法提供了时间动态的全局视角，但它们通常依赖于不灵活的启发式设计，例如预定义的周期长度、手动选择或随机采样的top-k频率分量，以及分离的频谱变换。因此，它们无法考虑到时频异质性问题，即在时间域中看似同步的变量在频率域中可能存在显著差异。与此同时，基于Mamba的预测模型尽管在长程建模方面具有高效性，但仅将频率信息作为辅助信号引入，留下……
tldr: 提出AdaMamba，一种自适应频率门控的Mamba模型，通过自适应地处理频率分量来解决时频异质性问题，从而提升长期时间序列预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: Proposes AdaMamba, an adaptive frequency-gated Mamba model that addresses time-frequency heterogeneity by adaptively handling frequency components, thereby improving the accuracy of long-term time series forecasting.
